title: 北京胡同里，藏着一杯咖啡香 | Coffee in a Beijing Hutong ☕
description:
灰墙灰瓦的百年胡同深处，飘来的不是茶香，而是一杯手冲咖啡——你会去老四合院里喝一杯吗？

In the gray-brick alleys of old Beijing, century-old courtyards (四合院) are quietly turning into specialty cafés. The beans come from the mountains of Yunnan; the signature drink is a "dirty" — espresso poured over cold milk, a favorite of the city's young coffee crowd. Old walls, new aroma. 您呐，慢慢喝。

京味彩蛋 / Beijing dialect: 「您呐」— a warm, polite Beijing way of addressing someone.

AI-assisted edit; footage licensed from Pexels (credited below). Subtitles are the narration — no voiceover.
